identification: Continental 900 standard silver repousse footed bowl, about 19 cm, floral and scroll embossing, cast scroll rim, three small feet. Photo 4 shows a '900' mark in the well. Origin unconfirmed (Middle Eastern, Persian or continental, 20th century).
searches_tried: pipeline/comps.py: '900 silver repousse bowl', 'continental silver fruit bowl', 'silver bowl', 'repousse', 'persian silver bowl'; work/comps.py: 'silver bowl footed embossed', '900 silver'. No same-item or close hits. Only unrelated items turned up (900 silver brooches, cigarette cases, bangles at Gowans, paid locally; plated bowls; a boxed lot at Armitage with a chased footed silver bowl, not comparable).
chrome_hint: eBay AU sold + Terapeak: '900 silver repousse bowl', 'continental silver embossed footed bowl', 'persian silver bowl repousse', 'German 800 silver embossed bowl', 'silver fruit bowl three feet repousse floral'. viewing_check: Weigh the bowl in grams (silver value floor). Photograph the full mark in the well and any other marks on the underside or feet (maker, country, 900, 800, crown, Persian or Turkish tughra) to settle origin. Check for dents, splits, and whether feet are solder-repaired. Confirm it is solid silver, not plated.
